## Professional positioning
Retail merchandise planning, commercial analysis, business strategy and digital growth. Anjanna Margam brings experience in multinational fashion retail planning to websites, search marketing, lead-generation and CRM workflows for Indian businesses.

His career began in education in Telangana in 1997. He subsequently worked in Saudi Arabia before progressing into merchandise planning and inventory management. The professional resume describes senior roles with Landmark Group / Max Fashion and Beside Group.

## Retail career
### Landmark Group / Max Fashion
October 2004–May 2015 | Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia.
Responsibilities reported: sales and buying budgets, open-to-buy, assortment and size analysis, demand forecasts, allocation, replenishment, stock ageing, pricing, margin review, promotions, markdown planning and retail reporting. The resume reports approximately SAR 600 million in sales and buying budget scope, regional network expansion from 5 to 22 stores, support for 21 store launches, and contribution to the BOSS-to-Oracle Retail Management System transition.

### Beside Group
June 2015–November 2020 | Dubai, UAE.
Multi-brand retail merchandise planning for fashion brands including Diesel, Fred Perry, Scotch & Soda, Pinko, Samuel & Kevin, Jigsaw and Carhartt. Market coverage: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar and Egypt. Responsibilities included sales and buying budgets, forecasts, OTB, assortment recommendations, sell-through, stock balancing, allocation, promotions, margins and trading reviews. No specific portfolio store-count figure is published pending reconciliation.

## India-based work since 2020
### JaiVibe
Founder & Digital Growth Strategist | June 2020–present.
Business website development, search engine optimization, digital campaigns, lead-generation journeys, CRM workflows, dashboards and reporting across real estate, hospitality, healthcare and local services.

### Sri Supraja Infracon
Real Estate & Digital Marketing Strategist | January 2026–present.
Project positioning, online visibility, campaign support, lead-generation content, CRM reporting, enquiry journeys and sales follow-up coordination.

## Capabilities
Retail: budget planning, OTB, forecasting, assortment and size planning, allocation, replenishment, pricing, margin and stock-ageing analysis, markdowns, clearance and performance reporting.
Digital: WordPress, Divi, Next.js workflows, SEO, paid campaigns, Google Analytics, Search Console, CRM lead management, WhatsApp follow-up and reporting.
Commercial: marketing planning, cross-functional coordination, operational reporting, business systems.
